Framework **Next.js (canary / v16)** — This is a bleeding-edge Next.js project. - `package.json` declares `"next": "^16.2.1-canary.45"` and `"react": "19.1.0"` / `"react-dom": "19.1.0"`. - The `next.config.ts` is minimal (empty config object), which means it uses all Next.js defaults. - The App Router is in use — the root is `/vercel/sandbox/app/` (no `pages/` directory exists). - The AI SDK is a first-class dependency: `"ai": "5.0.59"`, `"@ai-sdk/react": "2.0.0-beta.28"`, plus `"@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.17.0"` and `"zod": "^4.0.10"`. **Key file:** `/vercel/sandbox/package.json` ```json { "private": true, "type": "module", "scripts": { "dev": "next dev", "build": "next build", "start": "next start" }, "dependencies": { "@ai-sdk/react": "2.0.0-beta.28", "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.17.0", "ai": "5.0.59", "next": "^16.2.1-canary.45", "react": "19.1.0", "react-dom": "19.1.0", "zod": "^4.0.10" }, "devDependencies": { "@testing-library/dom": "^10.4.1", "@testing-library/react": "^16.1.0", "@types/node": "^20", "@types/react": "^19", "@types/react-dom": "^19", "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^4.4.1", "jsdom": "^27.4.0", "typescript": "^5", "vite-tsconfig-paths": "^5.1.4", "vitest": "^3.1.3" } } ``` --- ## 2. Project Structure The project is very small — a greenfield Next.js App Router app with no `src/` directory and no additional route segments yet. ``` /vercel/sandbox/ .gitignore .git/ next.config.ts package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json opencode.json node_modules/ app/ layout.tsx ← Root layout (HTML shell) page.tsx ← Root page (/) — Server Component with inline server action ContactForm.tsx ← Client-compatible component (no 'use client' directive yet) ``` There are **no subdirectories** inside `app/` (no `api/`, no nested routes). There are **no CSS files**, **no `public/` directory**, and **no separate `components/` directory**. --- ## 3. Component Conventions ### Server Components (default) Both `layout.tsx` and `page.tsx` are **Server Components** — no `'use client'` directive. This is the default in the App Router. **`/vercel/sandbox/app/layout.tsx`** — Standard root layout: ```tsx import type { Metadata } from 'next' export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Create Next App', description: 'Generated by create next app', } export default function RootLayout({ children, }: Readonly<{ children: React.ReactNode }>) { return ( {children} ) } ``` - Uses TypeScript with `Metadata` type export for SEO. - No CSS framework, no global styles, no custom fonts loaded yet. ### Plain function-export components **`/vercel/sandbox/app/ContactForm.tsx`** — A placeholder component: ```tsx export default function ContactForm() { // TODO: Implement contact form that sends data to save contact message return (

Contact Us

Contact form goes here

) } ``` - Default export, named function (matches filename). - No `'use client'` directive — currently rendered as a Server Component. - No styling system (plain JSX). - Contains a TODO indicating it should send data to a server action named something like `saveContactMessage`. ### Styling - **No CSS files exist** (no `globals.css`, no Tailwind config, no CSS modules). - **No styling framework** is configured. - All current markup uses bare HTML elements with no class names or style attributes. --- ## 4. Existing Server Actions and Form Patterns There is **one server action** defined inline in the page component. **`/vercel/sandbox/app/page.tsx`:** ```tsx import ContactForm from './ContactForm' // Example of existing server action async function updateProfile(formData: FormData) { 'use server' const name = formData.get('name') as string const email = formData.get('email') as string // Simulate database update console.log('Updating profile:', { name, email }) } export default function Page() { return (

Dashboard

) } ``` Key patterns observed: - Server action is defined as an **`async function`** with `'use server'` directive at the top of the function body. - The action takes **`FormData`** as its parameter (not a typed Zod schema — raw `formData.get()` with type assertions). - The action is passed directly to a `
` — this is native HTML form submission with Progressive Enhancement (no JavaScript required to submit). - No `useFormState`, `useActionState`, or any client-side form hooks — pure server-side form handling. - The `ContactForm` component has a TODO indicating a future server action called `saveContactMessage` should be wired up. --- ## 5. No AGENTS.md or README.md There are **no `AGENTS.md` or `README.md` files** in the project root or anywhere outside `node_modules/`. The glob search for `**/*.md` in the project root returned zero results (excluding `node_modules`). --- ## 6. TypeScript Configuration **`/vercel/sandbox/tsconfig.json`:** ```json { "compilerOptions": { "target": "ES2017", "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"], "strict": true, "jsx": "react-jsx", "module": "esnext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "paths": { "@/*": ["./*"] } }, "include": ["next-env.d.ts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", ".next/types/**/*.ts"], "exclude": ["node_modules", "EVAL.tsx"] } ``` - Uses `@/*` path alias mapping (e.g. `@/app/page` would resolve to `./app/page`). - Strict mode is enabled. - The `EVAL.tsx` file is explicitly excluded. --- ## 7. Other Notable Files **`/vercel/sandbox/opencode.json`:** A configuration file for the "opencode" tool with a Vercel provider and model configuration (GLM 5.1). Contains an API key, but this appears to be a sandbox environment configuration. **`/vercel/sandbox/.gitignore`:** Only lists `node_modules/`. **`/vercel/sandbox/next.config.ts`:** Empty configuration — all defaults: ```ts import type { NextConfig } from 'next' const nextConfig: NextConfig = {} export default nextConfig ``` --- ## Summary | Aspect | Finding | |---|---| | **Framework** | Next.js 16 canary (App Router) with React 19.1 | | **Project structure** | Flat `app/` directory (no `src/`, no nested routes) | | **Component style** | Default-export named functions, TypeScript, Server Components by default | | **Styling** | None configured yet (no CSS files, no Tailwind, no CSS modules) | | **Server actions** | 1 existing: `updateProfile` (inline in page.tsx), uses raw `FormData` | | **Forms** | Native `` pattern, no client-side hooks | | **AI/SDK** | `ai` (Vercel AI SDK v5), `@ai-sdk/react` v2 beta, `zod` v4 beta, MCP SDK | | **Path aliases** | `@/*` → `./*` | | **Testing** | Vitest + Testing Library configured (dev deps) | | **README / AGENTS.md** | None exist | session_id: ses_268399f3cffe688NCR52C86sAG
